prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in while turning left in Pearland. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened?

A: I was leaving a shopping center and heading toward the main road. I had to make a left turn across one lane of oncoming traffic.

Q: What was the weather and lighting like?

A: It was daylight and clear. The pavement was dry as far as I could tell.

Q: Walk me through what you saw before the impact.

A: I checked both directions. There was a gap, so I started to turn. About halfway through the turn, a vehicle coming toward me hit the front passenger side of my car. I didn't see it until just before it hit.

Q: Did you have your headlights on, and were you using your turn signal?

A: Headlights were on. I had my signal on for a good stretch before I started the turn.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my arm out to brace myself and my wrist took most of the force. I was told it's fractured, and I've been wearing a splint since.

Q: Have you received medical treatment since the collision?

A: I was seen at an urgent care that same day and then referred to an orthopedic doctor. I have a follow-up scheduled.

Q: Did anyone else report injuries?

A: My passenger didn't say anything was wrong, but I'm not sure they were checked.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?

A: Only that I'm sorry the other driver was hurt too, if they were. I just want my car looked at and my medical bills handled.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
